reference.about: 16x16 block means of (r+g+b)/3 of the Fox example at 256x256, 4 steps, seed 7, rendered by bonsai-native

steps.run: window.e2eGallery = document.getElementById('gallery').children.length, [...document.querySelectorAll('#examples button')].find((b) => b.textContent === 'Fox').click(), document.getElementById('size').value = '256x256', document.getElementById('steps').value = 4, document.getElementById('go').click()

steps.name: image matches the native rendering
steps.check: (() => { const c = document.getElementById('canvas'); const d = c.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; const n = 16, bw = c.width / n, bh = c.height / n, ref = SPEC.reference; let diff = 0; for (let by = 0; by < n; by++) for (let bx = 0; bx < n; bx++) { let s = 0; for (let y = by * bh; y < (by + 1) * bh; y++) for (let x = bx * bw; x < (bx + 1) * bw; x++) { const i = (y * c.width + x) * 4; s += d[i] + d[i + 1] + d[i + 2]; } diff += Math.abs(s / (3 * bw * bh) - ref.luma[by * n + bx]); } diff /= n * n; return { fail: diff > ref.max_mean_abs_diff && 'the image differs from the reference', info: `mean abs diff ${diff.toFixed(2)} / ${ref.max_mean_abs_diff}` }; })()
